stack_true.framework: LibreChat (Express API + Vite/React SPA, agents-based chat engine)

notes: Local LibreChat SPA. Soft-404 /admin,/dashboard,/manage,/graphql HTML shells are not real endpoints. Headers-only unauth surface is expected. AI detection is taxonomy/live-surface based (auth-gated 401 on /api/agents/chat and /api/agents/v1/chat/completions), not product-name hardcoding. Corrected from an earlier /api/messages|/api/ask reference — this container runs LibreChat's newer agents-based chat engine; /api/ask does not exist in this version's routes and /api/messages is conversation-history CRUD, not inference. /api/agents/chat/abort, /chat/active, /chat/status, /chat/stream are control-plane (status/cancel), not inference endpoints — a scanner that lists them as AI surfaces is misclassifying control plane as inference. NVD CVE mapping is off (fingerprint-only).
